name: [BETA] Sequence Basketball
desc:
Sequence Basketball brings competitive basketball to Roblox with deep player customization, rewarding progression, and gameplay where every possession matters. Create your own build, develop your badges, master your playstyle, and compete your way to the top. 🏀

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite the game to support Sequence Basketball and stay updated on new content and codes!

This game is in very early development and is open to the public for a bigger range of testing. Please stay patient with us as we fix all the bugs. Join our server to report bugs in the bug reporting channels.
